patterns.note: Full-screen sections transition on scroll, some featuring a split-screen layout with text on the left and an image or video on the right, while others are full-bleed media sections.
Small, uppercase, and widely-spaced text is consistently used for navigation and secondary labels, creating a minimalist and structured feel that contrasts with larger, more prominent body text.
A stark, high-contrast black and white base palette dominates the UI, with visual richness primarily derived from high-quality photography and video content.
Scrolling triggers full-screen section transitions, where the entire viewport content is replaced by the next section, often with a dynamic update to the top navigation.
The top navigation dynamically updates its links and descriptive text based on the currently active full-screen section, providing context-sensitive navigation.

technique_notes: Full-screen sections transition on scroll, likely using a JavaScript library like Swiper or a custom scroll-jacking implementation, where each scroll event advances to the next full-screen 'slide' or content block. The top navigation dynamically updates its links and descriptive text to reflect the content of the currently active section.
Video heroes are integrated as full-bleed background elements in certain sections, playing automatically to create an immersive and dynamic visual experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, readable body text and headings, contrasted with very small, uppercase, widely-spaced navigation and labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and sparse, with significant negative space around content elements, especially in the full-screen sections.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its dynamic, context-sensitive navigation that completely reconfigures its links and descriptive text as the user scrolls through full-screen, immersive project sections. This creates a highly curated and interactive portfolio experience, making the navigation an integral part of the storytelling rather than a static utility.
